PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
SELECT ?filmLater ?filmLaterLabel ?directorLater ?directorLaterLabel ?birthDateLater WHERE {
  dbr:Charlie_Chan_in_Honolulu dbo:director ?dir1 .
  dbr:Lianna dbo:director ?dir2 .
  ?dir1 dbo:birthDate ?b1 .
  ?dir2 dbo:birthDate ?b2 .
  BIND(IF(xsd:date(?b1) > xsd:date(?b2) , dbr:Charlie_Chan_in_Honolulu , dbr:Lianna) AS ?filmLater)
  BIND(IF(xsd:date(?b1) > xsd:date(?b2) , ?dir1 , ?dir2) AS ?directorLater)
  BIND(IF(xsd:date(?b1) > xsd:date(?b2) , ?b1 , ?b2) AS ?birthDateLater)
  OPTIONAL {
    ?filmLater rdfs:label ?filmLaterLabel
    FILTER(lang(?filmLaterLabel) = 'en')
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?directorLater rdfs:label ?directorLaterLabel
    FILTER(lang(?directorLaterLabel) = 'en')
  }
}
